text: A healthy lifestyle involves more than just eating well. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, provides essential nutrients for energy and immunity. Regular exercise, even thirty minutes of walking or cycling each day, strengthens the heart and improves mood. Equally important is sleep, as seven to nine hours of good rest helps the body repair and the mind process information. Mental health also matters; managing stress through hobbies or talking to friends is vital. Finally, work-life balance is key. Taking breaks, setting boundaries, and making time for relaxation prevent burnout and support overall wellbeing, creating a sustainable and fulfilling healthy routine.
